analyst_view.overall: Liam Rosenior's Paris FC are 4th after a 3-1 win over Monaco, in which they outshot them 19 to 9 with a high press. Will Still's Auxerre are 14th, lost 5-1 at Strasbourg and have conceded in five straight games, though they are unbeaten in three at home. Dioubaté is suspended after his red card there. L'Équipe reports Labeau-Lascary is back, while Tuanzebe is a doubt.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.5 goals. Auxerre's defence has leaked in every recent game and Paris FC arrive attacking with confidence, so we lean higher. Both previous league meetings were draws, the last 0-0, which keeps the lean mild.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.5 corners. Nothing in the news changes either side's approach to wide play.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.4 cards, already above average. Auxerre's red card last week hints at frustration, but we found nothing on referee Marc Bollengier, so we stay level.

shots.text: The numbers say 21.9 shots. Paris FC took 19 shots against Monaco with a high press, and Auxerre have been giving up chances, so we lean higher.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.2 shots on target. Paris FC put 10 on target against Monaco, and Auxerre's defence is short of bodies without Okoh and possibly Tuanzebe, so we lean higher.
